initial_review: Twenty-one excluded bodies; all remaining source exact after omitting line directives. Alternate endian/bit order, FIFO, non-NTVDM parity names, autoflush, short trace, two-port, IRET-hook and termios alternatives removed.
counter_review: Selected UART register layouts, NTVDM parity constants, four-port mapping and serial callbacks remain original. Source-matched non-directive lines retain original logical coordinates; anomalous line280/319/352/358 directives are superseded before such source or occur at EOF. This does not certify preprocessor-directive diagnostics or every compiled context.

line_check.method: Logical line counter over local directives; exact SequenceMatcher source chunks against pinned original. Not compiler-generated diagnostics.

limits: No new compilation/runtime proof or physical COM acceptance. Directive-line anomalies noted, not repaired.
